newsitem.title: USA: Shuffle Master insiders buy company stock.
newsitem.headline: Shuffle Master insiders buy company stock.

text.p: Shuffle Master Inc said Monday that three company insiders, including the company's founders, recently filed Form 4's with the Securities and Exchange Commission, reporting purchases of company stock in the open market within the last 60 days.

The company's founders, John Breeding, chairman of the board of directors and Diane Breeding, corporate secretary and director, acquired 51,800 shares through the month of March at prices ranging from $8 to $8.50 per share.

In a March filing, Shuffle Master's vice president of financial relations and corporate development, Gary Griffin, reported the purchase of 1,100 shares of Shuffle Master common stock at $9 per share.
Shuffle Master supplies shuffler systems and proprietary table and video games to the casino and gaming industry.
